lines: Shadows gushed out from Sakura's own shadow like jets of water.
A dozen or so kunai that she had been keeping hidden in her shadow were fired simultaneously.
Her aim was impeccably accurate. Her might was clear as well.
Having had their brains pierced through, the demon dogs were soundly defeated.
Meanwhile, Sakura herself, who had been attacked by an entire pack of them at once, hadn't sustained a single scratch.
Although she goofed around on a regular basis, the skillfulness of her technique was far from anything that even the young Sakura from another dimension could match.
However, she herself didn't look happy.
「I don't think this'll work, but one more time! “Shadow Kunai”!!!」
Once again, ten or so kunai flew out from her shadow, and a group of demon dogs collapsed in the exact same way.
「Aw, come on! They're not decreasing at all, are they?!」
Indeed, the number of enemies didn't diminish in the slightest.
New demon dogs were climbing over the corpses of their fallen comrades to attack her one after another.
「Wait a sec?! How many are you letting run wild?!」
「It's kinda like they're multiplying on their own, and looking closely, there are little ones too. Are those their children? Demon dog puppies?」
「Their barks are kinda cute, so it's hard to do. I'm starting to feel uneasy about the number of kunai in my shadow, too.」
Sakura gave up on fighting, and took flight.
I had finally had the piercings put on me.
It may not have been my own body, but this was still a humiliation.
I had been allowed to put my clothes back on, but that was no comfort whatsoever.
It throbbed painfully when the piercings rubbed against them.
I had been letting out nothing but groans for some time.
I answered, in a hoarse-sounding voice.
Because if I made an even slightly loud voice, it would go throb, throb, throb, just from that.
「Soon enough, havin' them on will be second nature.」
I wasn't a bit happy about that.
But it looked like, if that didn't happen, it would interfere with my mission from here on.
（I'm going to get used to this? Things have gotten out of hand......）
I thought wearily, my body throbbing with pain.
Kaura made a gesture like she was pulling on something with her fing―――
My “invisible chains” were pulled, and intense pain ran through the three spots that had been pierced.
I couldn't breathe from the sheer anguish.
I couldn't even crumple down, what with them being yanked in an upward direction.
Nor could I clutch them with my hands.
I just twitched and writhed, in a strange tiptoed pose.
Finally, she released me, making sure to give my “invisible chains” a light flick.
They were no longer being pulled, but the pain was pounding now.
「Ahaha! That was a really nice face you just made.」
「You've got a good idea of what the seal piercings are like, right?」
「Well, if you're going to disobey, only do it to me, okay?」
She chuckled at my dispirited response, and
「Now, finally, the inspection of your personal belongings.」
I had brought a toothbrush and toothpaste, soap, underwear, and other daily necessities.
She had said she was going to inspect them.
Her face changed from ultra-sadist piercing fetishist to the stern expression of an Amidahara warden.
「Is there any need to tell you that?」
「Of course. If it's a bomb, the damage might extend to me.」
Despite saying “I'll help you once”, that still didn't mean it was unconditional, huh?
However, I already expected that much.
I took out one of my daily necessities.
「GPS? What're you doing transmitting positional data?」
「Well, whatever. I'm going to check whether or not that really is a GPS transmitter.」
「If it's true, you can bring the toothbrush in. All other belongings will be confiscated.」
Kaura gave it back to me.
And so, I came to be imprisoned, with only my GPS transmitter toothbrush.
